title: Orthopedic Surgery
summary: On 19th October, an orthopedic surgery of young patient Anurag Gupta was successfully completed, and he was discharged in good health. Heartfelt appreciation to Rtn. Shyam Kedia for his generous contribution of ₹2,40,000 towards this noble cause.
